answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by pricing reputation instead of identity: new agents start with zero trust and must earn it through small, verifiable jobs attested by independent peers. A fake identity is like a mirror in an oasis - it looks real until you try to drink from it, because it has no history of completed work. A violet badge marking verified work history cannot be copied cheaply: building one takes weeks of real jobs, so flooding the market with fresh sock puppets buys no influence.
